profile.subtitleJa: 偵察隊が戻った荒野の宿営地
profile.summaryJa: カデシュは、民数記13:26で偵察隊が戻った場所として現れます。本文はそこをパランの荒野と結び付けます。
profile.identityNoteJa: カデシュの地点比定は、本文の短い地名だけでは確定しません。

facts.textJa: 後の記述はカデシュをツィンの荒野に置き、別の箇所はパランの荒野と結び付けます。両方を同じ地点とする説と、二地点とみる説があります。
後の発話では「エドムの境界の端の町」と説明されます。

profile.modernLocationJa: パランの荒野に結び付けられますが、現代の一点への比定は確定しません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 偵察隊の帰還地として記されます。
profile.locationNoteJa: 比定には異説があります。地図の点が表示される場合も、特定説を示す確定地点ではなく参考候補です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.
The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.
Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.
They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
